messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth reported a P1: dedicated pool embeddings are timing out on some requests since the kernel tweak earlier today. oncall-bot created INC-2026-042. Need engineering commitments for customer-facing mitigation and ETA so CS can update the customer.

Ajay: I can own either a rollback of the kernel change or a hotfix guard. Need infra +1 for rollback.

Maya: Two clear options we discussed: rollback (fast, known-good commit) or hotfix (safer but longer). Customer wants a short ETA.

Ajay: Rollback details: revert commit `0a1b2c3` (mem-opt). Command: ```git revert 0a1b2c3 && ./deploy/canary.sh --pool=dedicated``` Canary & staging smoke must pass. ETA ~45m if infra helps.

Kevin: Infra +1 for rollback. I can run canary and monitor. Schedule in ~30m. :thumbsup:

Lucy: I'll run QA smoke (embedding flow + KV cache check). Need the exact deploy tag once canary build is ready. QA ETA 1h after canary starts.

Sam: If rollback shows regression, I can push a hotfix that forces `batch_size=1` for affected paths and adds a defensive check — PR ready to iterate (not yet merged). Hotfix ETA ~3h, PR #1234.

Maya: CS needs a single-line commitment for the customer: either "rollback by 10:15 PT" or "hotfix ETA 3h". Which do we want to promise?

Ajay: I'm taking rollback as primary. ETA 45m — failover to Sam's hotfix if canary fails. I'll post updates every 15m in this thread.

Kevin: Canary slot booked at 10:00 PT. I'll run the canary against 10% traffic in staging -> small production window once green.

Lucy: I'll have the smoke checklist ready and a quick validation script. Adding snippet to run locally: `python tests/embed_smoke.py --endpoint staging`

devex-bot: Reminder — if you revert a commit, add runbooks + PR notes (use the PR template).

Maya: Action items and owners: (1) Ajay — rollback path & deploy (45m) (2) Kevin — infra canary & monitor (10:00 PT) (3) Lucy — QA smoke & validation (1h) (4) Sam — prepare hotfix PR as fallback (3h) (5) Maya — customer communication and SLA note (10:15 PT). Please react with ack.

Ajay: ack.

Sam: ack, prepping PR and tests.

Lucy: ack, will post smoke results here.

Kevin: ack, will post canary logs and SLO dashboards link.

Maya: I posted a provisional update to #customer-success and set a +2h follow-up reminder. Will send a concise customer ETA after first canary result. Link to postmortem template: <https://docs.internal/postmortems/template>

Maya: If rollback succeeds, we'll keep the hotfix as follow-up to harden batching behavior and add an automated guard. If rollback fails, Sam takes lead.

Ajay: On it — starting pre-rollback checklist now (checking model variants, KV cache warmup). Will post `deploy_id` and progress.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status updated: mitigation in progress (owner: Ajay).

Maya: Thanks all, please keep updates short and inline. CS will hold customer at "mitigation in progress, ETA 45m" until we confirm canary.
